svg.aria-label: Mabrur — earmarks each pilgrim's umrah prepayment line by line so the agency can pay only that pilgrim's licensed vendors. Agen membayar hotel Ibu Siti dari dana Pak Ahmad — cap merah DITOLAK · EarmarkMismatch mendarat di kuitansi. The same invoice is then paid on Ibu Siti's own booking: LUNAS.
